item.title: No, This Old Photo Does Not Show Sonia Gandhi Dancing In A Bar
item.description: The viral photograph does not show Sonia Gandhi. It is a 1967 image of go-go dancers performing at a hotel in Auburn, Sydney, during a brewery workers’ strike that caused a beer shortage.

item.title: Viral Videos Of PM Narendra Modi, Benjamin Netanyahu Pledging Aid To Taliban Are Doctored
item.description: There is no evidence that Narendra Modi or Benjamin Netanyahu announced support or aid to Afghanistan’s Taliban government during their Knesset addresses. Viral videos were found to be manipulated.

item.title: This Photo Does Not Show Pakistan’s Recent Airstrikes On Kabul
item.description: The viral image is old and unrelated to the recent military escalation between Pakistan and Afghanistan.

item.title: Did Israeli Opposition Boycott PM Modi’s Speech At The Knesset?
item.description: Israeli opposition lawmakers did not boycott Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s address. They boycotted the speeches of Benjamin Netanyahu and Amir Ohana but attended and welcomed PM Modi’s speech in the Knesset.
